experiments.title: Full-request tracing
experiments.scope: Instrument existing boundaries before moving code
experiments.hypothesis: Significant waiting is in admission, repeated preparation or model stages rather than language overhead
experiments.validation: Paired requests, monotonic spans, failed/time-out inclusion; disjoint critical-path reporting
experiments.rollback: No runtime default change; trace off switch

experiments.title: Existing native backend portability
experiments.scope: Validate merged native/litha_search rather than create another index
experiments.hypothesis: Resident extension remains correct and portable on supported Windows/Linux interpreters
experiments.validation: Build/import/absence/ABI mismatch/fallback; clean startup without compiler; exact rank and source identity
experiments.stop_conditions: Crash, silent fallback, changed rank/permission behavior or incompatible wheel

experiments.title: Request-scoped history validation reuse
experiments.scope: Reuse verified digest only within trustworthy revision scope
experiments.hypothesis: Repeated immutable-state validation can be removed without skipping checks
experiments.validation: Edits/deletes/restore/scope switches and byte-identical prompt tests; whole-turn timing
experiments.rollback: Disable reuse, return to source validation path
experiments.stop_conditions: Stale/misattributed history or nontrivial tail-latency regression

experiments.title: Shared admission and CPU thread budget
experiments.scope: Coordinate foreground/background resources without adding another unbounded pool
experiments.hypothesis: One measured device/host policy improves interactive P95 under background load
experiments.validation: Concurrency 1/2/4 within capacity; CPU/RAM/VRAM and task completion; cancellation and starvation
experiments.stop_conditions: OOM, lost jobs, starvation, duplicated external effects

experiments.title: Resident client and loop lifecycle
experiments.scope: Reuse validated connections/lifetimes within Qt and thread ownership rules
experiments.hypothesis: Avoid repeated setup without breaking cancellation or shutdown
experiments.validation: Foreground chat startup/stream first useful output; shutdown/reconnect and invalid credential tests
experiments.stop_conditions: Cross-thread failures, leaked work, delayed cancellation or credential reuse across scope

experiments.title: Bounded exact retrieval
experiments.scope: Compare improved Python/native scanning at real corpus sizes
experiments.hypothesis: Packed data and bounded top-k help a measured stage, not every task
experiments.validation: Current native module; end-to-end conversion/metadata overhead; near-ties; peak RSS/startup
experiments.rollback: Python backend and previous immutable snapshot
experiments.stop_conditions: Wrong sources, partial index served as complete, memory cap or latency regressions

experiments.title: Prompt and evidence cache correctness
experiments.hypothesis: Stable eligible prefixes reduce prefill without stale evidence
experiments.validation: Cache hit/miss and actual processed tokens; tool-list changes; deleted documents; out-of-scope tests
experiments.stop_conditions: Stale facts, unsupported citations, changed privacy or invalidation failure

experiments.title: ANN only beyond exact crossover
experiments.scope: Prototype separate opt-in index snapshot behind existing contract
experiments.hypothesis: Approximate search offers worthwhile tail benefit above measured corpus size
experiments.validation: Recall/rank quality on held-out data, index build cost, deletion/filter behavior, exact fallback
experiments.stop_conditions: Lost required evidence, no full-stage gain, unsafe freshness/scoping

experiments.title: Native inference tuning
experiments.scope: Tune installed native engine without replacing orchestration
experiments.hypothesis: Batch/cache/quantization/speculation settings may improve accepted throughput
experiments.validation: Same model/taskset; cold/warm prefill/decode; first meaningful output; quality and RAM/VRAM
experiments.stop_conditions: Quality loss, OOM, silent cloud route or foreground delay

experiments.title: Model-specific Rust/ONNX runtime trial
experiments.scope: Isolate an embedding/reranker or modality before considering generation migration
experiments.hypothesis: A specific model/device can benefit from a tested alternative backend
experiments.validation: Exact preprocessing/tokenizer/model parity, device transfer cost, provider coverage, output quality
experiments.stop_conditions: Unsupported operators, numerical quality loss or transfer overhead erases gain

experiments.title: Verification-budget allocation
experiments.scope: Spend genuine latency savings on independent checking
experiments.hypothesis: Bounded candidate/test allocation improves verified outcomes per time
experiments.validation: Correctness rate and latency jointly, held-out tasks, Luau/Rust checks and real visual tests when relevant
experiments.rollback: Prior candidate budget and independent gate
experiments.stop_conditions: Checker gaming, unverified successes, destructive tool effects or GPU saturation

experiments.title: Compiler and kernel tuning
experiments.hypothesis: A measured hotspot may improve after architecture bottlenecks are resolved
experiments.validation: Portable release baseline, held-out PGO workload, scalar reference, target-CPU compatibility
experiments.stop_conditions: Illegal instruction, numerical drift, machine-specific release or no application gain
